description: Terri Carver is the Republican candidate for Colorado State Senate District 9. Terri Carver served in the United States Air Force as a JAG (military lawyer) and retired as a Colonel after 29 years of combined active duty and reserve service. She has a proven conservative record and is committed to Fighting for You!
